risks: We're transparent: delays can happen—from fine-tuning 3D-printing parameters to securing gas certifications. To stay ahead, we've built buffer time into our production schedule and pre-sourced raw silica and noble gases from verified suppliers. Scaling from prototype to mass production is our biggest hurdle. We're mitigating this by running pilot batches before full manufacturing, ensuring consistent quality and tolerances. We're also actively upgrading to a lighter silica composite and refining structural geometry for added strength without sacrificing recyclability. If improvements emerge during testing, we'll transparently share updates and roll them into the final design—even if it shifts timelines slightly. Backer communication will be weekly, so you're never in the dark.

faq.a: REAZENABLE A300 is a plasma-based ambient light designed to bring dynamic, atmospheric light into everyday spaces. Inside the glass sphere, glowing plasma continuously shifts and flows, creating a light experience that is never exactly the same twice.

faq.q: Is REAZENABLE A300 an LED lamp?
faq.a: No. REAZENABLE A300 creates light through plasma rather than conventional LED illumination. The light comes from the energized gas inside the glass sphere.

Plasma is often called the fourth state of matter. It is the same state of matter found in the sun, stars, lightning, and auroras. RREAZENABLE A300 brings this phenomenon into a compact, designed object for the home.

faq.q: What gas is inside the glass sphere?
faq.a: The sphere contains a controlled mixture of noble and inert gases, including Xenon, Krypton and Neon. These gases are chemically stable and contained inside the sealed sphere.

faq.q: Does the plasma always look the same?
faq.a: No. The plasma is dynamic by nature. Its shape and movement change as you interact with the control knob, so every moment can look slightly different.

faq.q: How do I control REAZENABLE A300?
faq.a: REAZENABLE A300 is controlled through a physical knob on the base. No app, Wi-Fi, or internet connection is required.
The knob changes the behavior and intensity of the plasma, allowing you to explore different patterns and visual effects.

faq.q: Where can I use REAZENABLE A300?
faq.a: REAZENABLE A300 is designed for living rooms, bedrooms, desks, studios, creative spaces, and hospitality environments. It works as both ambient lighting and a sculptural light object.

faq.q: Does REAZENABLE A300 produce ozone or odor?
faq.a: No. The plasma is contained within a sealed glass sphere using chemically stable gases. Under normal operation, there is no smoke or noticeable odor.

Like other electrical devices, REAZENABLE A300 generates some heat during operation. The product is designed with thermal management and ventilation in mind. The glass sphere may feel warm during use.

faq.q: Is REAZENABLE A300 safe for everyday use?
faq.a: REAZENABLE A300 is designed for normal indoor use with the plasma contained inside the sealed glass sphere. Please follow the included safety instructions and keep the product away from water and blocked ventilation.
No. The plasma is completely contained inside the sealed glass sphere. You interact with the product through the external control knob.

faq.q: Does A300 need an app or internet connection?
faq.a: No. A300 is a self-contained product. Plug it in, turn the knob, and use it.

faq.q: How should I place and clean REAZENABLE A300?
faq.a: Place it on a stable, hard, heat-resistant surface with adequate ventilation. To clean it, unplug the product and allow it to cool before wiping the glass and base with a soft cloth.

faq.q: Are the prototypes shown in the campaign the final product?
faq.a: The campaign prototypes are fully functional units used to validate the plasma system, structure, interaction, and overall design. Some details may still be refined before final production.

updates.title: The Story Behind A300: Italian Design Meets a Happy Accident in the Lab
updates.text:
Some ideas begin with a sketch. Others begin with something unexpected.
The story behind REAZENABLE A300 brings together Italian design and the spirit of discovery in the lab—a meeting of considered form and the unpredictable beauty of plasma.
Inside the glass, light moves and changes. The design gives that movement a place in everyday life: on your desk, in your favorite corner, beside the moments you keep for yourself.
Watch the story behind A300, and discover where design meets serendipity.
